notes.title: It's time to demolish! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome, Demolisher! 💣[/b][/h1]

[h3]Open your own demolition business! Start from the bottom and get high(er)! [/h3]

Demolition, destruction, demolition, devastation, demolition, explosives... Yep, that's all you need to know about this job. You're good to go, get behind the wheel of a demolition excavator with a wrecking ball and get to work, you have job to do. 💪
[previewyoutube=YSWm6fbdbTI;full][/previewyoutube]
Players, as our game is still in a very early stage of development, we would like to invite you on a journey together through creating our game, all the way through! It won't be easy, but that's what we have explosives for! 💥

[h3][b]So apart from destruction, what else can you expect in the game? 🤔[/b][/h3]
You can manage your crew in some of the craziest demo jobs this continent has ever seen. Gear up, hire the most incompetent employees, have a cold one, and build your own demolition business! Every day it's going to be like the best day ever!

So if you want to stay up to date, don't forget to add Demomen Ltd. to your Steam wishlist and press the follow button, then you won't miss any news!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946750/Demomen_Ltd/

Also, join the discussions on our Discord 👇
